feeds.title: Soli Lazarus Blog
feeds.description: Soli Lazarus is an ADHD coach, mentor, and trainer. Soli is a former SENCO and an expert in her field with over 30 years of experience. Providing one to one coaching, online membership providing ADHD training, monthly support group and training for parent groups and schools.

feeds.title: The Scottish ADHD Coalition
feeds.description: The Scottish ADHD Coalition is a new organization bringing together the leaders of voluntary organizations and groups providing support to adults and children with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) in Scotland, and their parents, carers and families.

feeds.title: ADHD in Children Support · Because parenting alone is hard enough
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Vicki and I'm a single mum of three beautiful children, a twin boy and a girl age 11, and a little boy age 8. Parenting is bloody hard and I'm a fan of anyone who admits it. I want a space where like-minded parents can come together, share ideas, what works, what doesn't work, vent, scream laugh, and support one another through this rollercoaster journey.

feeds.title: The ADHD Centre Blog
feeds.description: The ADHD centre is a team of experienced Consultant Psychiatrists, Psychologists, and ADHD Behavioural Coaches. Our mission is to offer a highly professional, confidential and affordable healthcare service that aims to diagnose and treat adults with ADHD in the UK using the latest effective, proven safe evidence-based treatments.

feeds.title: ADHD Richmond Blog
feeds.description: ADHD Richmond & Kingston is a voluntary support group that has been set up to provide support and information to parents, carers, and families of children diagnosed with ADHD. Follow this blog to find the latest news, tips, advice, & information, also read about the route to an ADHD diagnosis for children.
